integrity: Finite deterministic and seeded checks of the new derivation; not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent centrally symmetric inputs in linear general position; explicit radial formulas assume isotropic independent directions and independent identically distributed positive radii; the third moment concerns four unit-sphere vertices in dimension three only. The 1971 primary article could not be fully inspected, and historical priority is provisional. The sign-orbit reduction is classical in mechanism and is not asserted independently novel.
title: Conditional-volume moments of centrally containing random simplices and the skewness of spherical tetrahedra
